[SWS_FrTrcv_00395]
⌈If
an
error
is
not
detected
(e.g.
the
state
of
the
ERRN
pin
is
passive
high)
the
module
shall
execute
Dem_SetEventStatus(
FRTRCV_E_FR_ERRN_TRCV_<TrcvIdx>, DEM_EVENT_STATUS_PREPASSED).
In the above descriptions, <TrcvIdx> represents the transceiver index.⌋()
Note: It is possible that ERRN status is active only for a short time. There is a possibility
that ERRN status has already vanished when the MainFunction is executed. In this
case, ERRN could be connected to an interrupt pin in the actual hardware. This way
the transceiver driver would detect any active transitions of the ERRN status.
